content.value_statement: Spreadsheet data is hard to inspect quickly when values are in shared Google Sheets. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to read ranges with the gws CLI.
actual_capabilities: Guides reading Google Sheets values by spreadsheet ID and range.
Shows examples for cell ranges and full sheet reads.
States that the read command does not modify spreadsheets.
Links to shared Google Workspace authentication guidance.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and authenticated Google Workspace access.
Does not cover write operations, formatting, or sheet creation.
Advanced options require the raw values.get API.
Results depend on spreadsheet permissions and available sheet data.

use_cases.title: Review a Report Range
use_cases.description: Read a selected range from a team spreadsheet before summarizing values or checking missing cells.

use_cases.title: Check Operational Data
use_cases.description: Fetch current values from a tracking sheet without changing formulas, formatting, or shared content.

use_cases.title: Validate Spreadsheet Inputs
use_cases.description: Read known ranges from a test sheet when verifying an integration that depends on Google Sheets values.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Small Range
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gws-sheets-read to read spreadsheet <ID> range Sheet1!A1:D10. Summarize the visible rows.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Full Sheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gws-sheets-read to read spreadsheet <ID> range Sheet1. Report the column names and row count.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Ranges
prompt_templates.prompt: Read ranges Input!A1:C20 and Output!A1:C20 from spreadsheet <ID>. Describe value differences in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Imported Values
prompt_templates.prompt: Read spreadsheet <ID> range Import!A1:F100. Preserve row order, note blank cells, and flag values that need review.

output_examples.input: Read Sheet1!A1:C3 from a sales spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: The range contains three rows. The columns are Month, Revenue, and Owner. Revenue is blank in the third row.

output_examples.input: Read the Budget tab from a planning spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: The sheet includes category names, planned amounts, and actual amounts. Travel and software have the largest variances.

output_examples.input: Read Import!A1:F100 and identify values that need review.
output_examples.output: Several rows have blank owner fields. Two date values use a different format from the rest of the sheet.

best_practices: Use the narrowest range that contains the data you need.
Confirm spreadsheet permissions before asking the agent to read values.
Summarize sensitive sheet data instead of exposing unnecessary row details.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for edits, formatting, or sheet creation.
Do not request whole spreadsheets when a smaller range is enough.
Do not paste spreadsheet IDs into public prompts or shared logs.

faq.question: Can this skill edit spreadsheets?
faq.answer: No. It documents a read-only command for retrieving values from Google Sheets.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: You need a spreadsheet ID and a range, such as Sheet1!A1:D10.

faq.question: Does it require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated for the target Google Workspace account.

faq.question: Can it read a full sheet?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show reading a named sheet when the range is the sheet name.

faq.question: Does it expose advanced Sheets API options?
faq.answer: No. The skill says to use the raw values.get API for advanced options.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
